blurb: An encyclopedic tree of models: physical cosmologies, traditional and religious cosmologies, and individual and civilisational developmental stage models, including integral and metamodern thought.

nodes.name: Physical cosmological models
nodes.what: From ancient flat-earth cosmoi through geocentric and heliocentric systems to relativistic Big Bang cosmology and its open problems

children.name: Ancient and classical models
children.what: Pre-telescopic models of the heavens built from geometry, myth and philosophical principle

children.name: Mesopotamian flat-earth cosmos
children.what: Flat disc earth under a solid heaven, ringed by cosmic ocean, with an underworld below; see section 2 for detail

children.name: Egyptian cosmos of Nut and Geb
children.what: Sky goddess Nut arched over earth god Geb, raised by Shu; sun barque crosses sky by day and Duat by night; see section 2

children.name: Homeric flat disc earth
children.what: Earth as a disc encircled by the river Okeanos beneath a bronze or iron sky-dome

children.name: Anaximander's cylinder earth
children.what: Earth a free-floating cylinder at the centre of nested wheels of fire for stars, moon and sun; first mechanical model

children.name: Pythagorean central fire
children.what: Earth, Sun, Moon, planets and counter-earth revolve around a hidden central fire; first non-geocentric scheme

children.name: Harmony of the spheres
children.what: Orbs produce inaudible music in numerical ratios; mathematical order of the cosmos

children.name: Platonic Timaeus cosmos
children.what: Demiurge fashions a living ordered cosmos from the Forms, with world soul and circles of Same and Other

children.name: Eudoxian homocentric spheres
children.what: 27 nested concentric spheres reproduce planetary retrogradation geometrically

children.name: Aristotelian spheres
children.what: Finite geocentric cosmos of 55 spheres; sublunar four elements, supralunar aether; Unmoved Movers

children.name: Aristarchan heliocentrism
children.what: Sun at the centre with Earth rotating and orbiting; stars immensely distant

children.name: Eratosthenes' measurement of Earth
children.what: Spherical Earth circumference estimated from shadow angles at Syene and Alexandria

children.name: Ptolemaic epicycles
children.what: Geocentric system with deferents, epicycles, eccentrics and equants predicting planetary positions

children.name: Stoic finite cosmos in infinite void
children.what: Finite living pneuma-permeated cosmos floating in infinite void

children.name: Epicurean infinite worlds
children.what: Atoms and void; countless worlds arise and perish by swerve and collision

children.name: Indian Aryabhata model
children.what: Rotating Earth, epicycle planetary model with sidereal periods

children.name: Medieval and Islamic refinements
children.what: Critiques and elaborations of the Ptolemaic and Aristotelian systems

children.name: Philoponus impetus theory
children.what: Rejects Aristotelian celestial/terrestrial divide; motion sustained by impressed force

children.name: Maragha school and the Tusi couple
children.what: Non-Ptolemaic planetary models eliminating the equant; Tusi couple later echoed by Copernicus

children.name: Ibn al-Haytham's Doubts on Ptolemy
children.what: Demands physically real models rather than purely mathematical devices

children.name: Buridan and Oresme on Earth's rotation
children.what: Nicole Oresme argues a rotating Earth is as consistent as a rotating heaven

children.name: Cusa's decentred universe
children.what: Universe without centre or circumference; every place a centre

children.name: Early modern heliocentrism
children.what: From Copernicus to Newton: displacement of Earth, ellipses and mechanical law

children.name: Copernican heliocentrism
children.what: Sun near centre, Earth a planet rotating daily and orbiting yearly; stellar parallax absence explained by distance

children.name: Tychonic system
children.what: Planets orbit the Sun, which orbits a fixed central Earth; empirically equivalent geoheliocentric compromise
children.law: Sun orbits Earth, planets orbit Sun

children.name: Giordano Bruno's infinite universe
children.what: Infinite universe with innumerable stars as suns bearing inhabited worlds

children.name: Kepler's Mysterium Cosmographicum
children.what: Six planetary orbits fitted to nested Platonic solids; geometric theology of the cosmos

children.name: Kepler's laws of planetary motion
children.what: Elliptical orbits; equal areas in equal times; period squared proportional to semi-major axis cubed

children.name: Kepler's Harmonices Mundi
children.what: Planetary angular speeds mapped to musical scales; third law found here

children.name: Galileo's telescopic evidence
children.what: Moons of Jupiter, phases of Venus, lunar mountains, sunspots undermine the celestial/terrestrial divide

children.name: Cartesian vortices
children.what: Plenum filled with whirling matter vortices carrying planets; mechanical, contact-only causation

children.name: Newtonian absolute space
children.what: Universal gravitation in absolute space and time; infinite static universe in a void

children.name: Leibnizian relational space
children.what: Space and time as relations among things, not containers; principle of sufficient reason

children.name: Olbers' paradox
children.what: Why is the night sky dark in an infinite static eternal universe?
children.law: infinite static stars imply bright sky

children.name: Wright, Kant and Lambert island-universe vision
children.what: Milky Way as disc of stars; nebulae as distant galaxies

children.name: Kant-Laplace nebular hypothesis
children.what: Solar system forms from a rotating cloud that flattens and condenses into Sun and planets

children.name: Herschel's Milky Way model
children.what: Star-gauging yields a flattened disc galaxy with Sun near centre

children.name: Laplacian determinism
children.what: A sufficiently vast intellect could predict the future from present state of the universe

children.name: Heat death
children.what: Second law drives universe toward uniform maximum entropy

children.name: Island universes and the Great Debate
children.what: Twentieth-century resolution of the galaxy question

children.name: Shapley-Curtis Great Debate
children.what: Dispute over size of Milky Way and nature of spiral nebulae

children.name: Hubble's Andromeda distance
children.what: Cepheid variables prove spirals are galaxies far beyond Milky Way

children.name: Einstein's static universe
children.what: Closed, static, finite universe with cosmological constant balancing gravity

children.name: De Sitter universe
children.what: Empty vacuum-dominated expanding solution with cosmological constant; exponential growth

children.name: Friedmann solutions
children.what: Homogeneous isotropic expanding or contracting universes with closed, flat, open geometry

children.name: Lemaitre's primeval atom
children.what: Universe expanding from a single quantum state; earliest Big Bang proposal

children.name: Hubble-Lemaitre law
children.what: Recession velocity proportional to distance; evidence of expansion

children.name: FLRW metric
children.what: Standard metric for homogeneous isotropic expanding spacetime

children.name: Milne kinematic cosmology
children.what: Expansion as kinematic motion in flat spacetime with special relativity; cosmological principle

children.name: Dirac's large numbers hypothesis
children.what: Coincidences among huge dimensionless numbers imply a decaying gravitational constant

children.name: Tolman oscillating universe
children.what: Cyclic closed universe with entropy growing each bounce

children.name: Godel's rotating universe
children.what: Rotating solution of Einstein equations permitting closed timelike curves

children.name: Steady-state theory
children.what: Universe eternal and unchanging on large scale; matter continuously created to fill expansion

children.name: Gamow alpha-beta-gamma theory
children.what: Hot early universe builds light elements; predicts relic radiation

children.name: Big Bang nucleosynthesis
children.what: Hot early universe forges H, He-4, D, He-3, Li-7 in first minutes

children.name: Cosmic microwave background
children.what: Relic radiation at 2.7 K discovered; decisive against steady state

children.name: Hot Big Bang standard model
children.what: Expanding universe from hot dense state; CMB, expansion, light elements, structure

children.name: Penrose-Hawking singularity theorems
children.what: General relativity predicts singularities under reasonable conditions

children.name: Quasi-steady-state cosmology
children.what: Revived steady state with periodic creation events

children.name: Inflation and precision cosmology
children.what: Early-universe accelerated expansion and the concordance model

children.name: Guth's inflation
children.what: Brief exponential expansion in the first instants solves horizon, flatness and monopole problems

children.name: Starobinsky inflation
children.what: Inflation from R-squared quantum corrections to gravity; matches Planck data

children.name: New inflation
children.what: Slow-roll inflation avoiding Guth's graceful-exit problem

children.name: Chaotic inflation
children.what: Inflation from large scalar field values with generic initial conditions

children.name: Inflationary perturbations and structure
children.what: Quantum fluctuations during inflation seed galaxies and CMB anisotropies

children.name: Lambda-CDM
children.what: Concordance model: cosmological constant, cold dark matter, baryons, flat geometry, inflationary seed
children.law: about 68% dark energy, 27% dark matter, 5% baryons

children.name: Accelerating expansion
children.what: Type Ia supernovae show expansion speeding up; Nobel 2011

children.name: WMAP and Planck results
children.what: Precision CMB measurements constrain six-parameter LCDM

children.name: Cosmic web and large-scale structure
children.what: Filaments, walls, voids and clusters seeded by primordial fluctuations

children.name: Fine-tuning and anthropic principle
children.what: Constants appear tuned for life; observer selection explains values

children.name: Hartle-Hawking no-boundary proposal
children.what: Universe from a Euclidean quantum geometry with no initial singularity

children.name: Vilenkin tunnelling from nothing
children.what: Universe nucleates by quantum tunnelling from nothing

children.name: Pre-Big-Bang string cosmology
children.what: Dilaton-driven inflation before a string-scale bounce

children.name: Ekpyrotic universe
children.what: Big Bang as collision of branes in higher dimensional space

children.name: Cyclic model (Steinhardt-Turok)
children.what: Endless cycles of brane collisions with dark-energy phase and contraction

children.name: Conformal cyclic cosmology
children.what: Aeons succeed each other; conformal rescaling joins infinite future of one to Big Bang of next

children.name: Loop quantum cosmology
children.what: Quantum geometry replaces Big Bang singularity with a Big Bounce

children.name: Emergent universe
children.what: Universe begins as past-eternal Einstein static state then inflates

children.name: Black-hole cosmology
children.what: Our universe is interior of a black hole in a parent universe

children.name: Cosmological natural selection
children.what: Universes reproduce via black holes with slightly varying constants

children.name: Everett many-worlds
children.what: Universal wavefunction branches; all outcomes realised

children.name: Eternal inflation
children.what: Inflation never ends globally; endless pocket universes nucleate

children.name: Multiverse hypothesis
children.what: Collective term for many-universe scenarios; Tegmark's four levels

children.name: String landscape
children.what: About 10^500 flux vacua of string theory, each with different low-energy physics

children.name: Swampland program
children.what: Constraints identifying effective field theories not completable into quantum gravity

children.name: Mathematical universe hypothesis
children.what: Physical reality is a mathematical structure

children.name: Alternatives to dark matter and dark energy
MOND
children.what: Newtonian dynamics modified at low accelerations to explain galaxy rotation without dark matter

children.name: TeVeS
children.what: Relativistic extension of MOND using tensor-vector-scalar fields

children.name: Emergent gravity
children.what: Gravity as entropic emergent phenomenon; dark matter as apparent effect

children.name: f(R) gravity
children.what: Generalised action replaces R; can mimic dark energy

children.name: Quintessence
children.what: Dynamical scalar field in place of cosmological constant

children.name: Primordial black hole dark matter
children.what: Dark matter as primordial black holes formed in early universe

children.name: Timescape cosmology
children.what: Inhomogeneity and backreaction explain apparent acceleration

children.name: Tired light
children.what: Redshift from photon energy loss instead of expansion; falsified

children.name: Plasma cosmology
children.what: Electromagnetic plasma dynamics dominate structure; rejected by mainstream

children.name: Informational and simulation views
children.what: Digital and informational ontologies of the universe

children.name: Digital physics
children.what: Universe as computation on a discrete substrate

children.name: Holographic principle
children.what: Information in a volume encoded on its boundary; AdS/CFT realisation

children.name: Simulation hypothesis
children.what: Reality might be a computer simulation by an advanced civilisation; untestable philosophical status

children.name: Participatory anthropic principle
children.what: Observers help bring the universe into being through observation

children.name: Dark energy
children.what: What causes accelerated expansion: cosmological constant, quintessence or modified gravity

children.name: Cosmological constant problem
children.what: Quantum vacuum energy predicts value up to 120 orders too high

children.name: Dark matter
children.what: Unseen mass inferred from rotation curves, lensing and CMB; nature unknown

children.name: Hubble tension
children.what: Local distance-ladder H0 about 73 conflicts with CMB-inferred about 67 km/s/Mpc

children.name: S8 tension
children.what: Weak-lensing structure amplitude lower than CMB prediction

children.name: Baryogenesis
children.what: Why matter exceeds antimatter; Sakharov conditions unmet quantitatively

children.name: Horizon problem
children.what: Why causally disconnected regions share the same CMB temperature

children.name: Flatness problem
children.what: Why spatial curvature is so near zero

children.name: Initial conditions and entropy problem
children.what: Why was early entropy so low; arrow of time

children.name: Initial singularity
children.what: Whether the Big Bang was a true singularity or a quantum-gravity transition

children.name: Quantum gravity
children.what: No agreed theory unifying general relativity and quantum mechanics

children.name: Measurement problem and cosmology
children.what: Role of observers in a closed universe wavefunction

children.name: Lithium problem
children.what: Predicted primordial Li-7 abundance exceeds observation by about 3 times

children.name: Cosmic anomalies of the CMB
children.what: Low quadrupole, hemispherical asymmetry and cold spot hint at tensions

children.name: Fermi paradox and Great Filter
children.what: Where is everybody; implications for cosmic life
